ps2.9:2.2: saddhābalaṃ viriyabalaṃ satibalaṃ samādhibalam paññābalaṃ, hiribalaṃ ottappabalaṃ paṭisaṅkhānabalaṃ bhāvanābalaṃ anavajjabalaṃ saṅgahabalaṃ, khantibalaṃ paññattibalaṃ nijjhantibalaṃ issariyabalaṃ adhiṭṭhānabalaṃ samathabalaṃ vipassanābalaṃ, dasa sekhabalāni, dasa asekhabalāni, dasa khīṇāsavabalāni, dasa iddhibalāni, dasa Tathāgatabalāni. Paṭis_II,IX.2:
ps2.9:3.3: sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ upatthambhanaṭṭhena saddhābalaṃ, kilesānaṃ pariyādānaṭṭhena saddhābalaṃ, paṭivedhādivisodhanaṭṭhena saddhābalaṃ, cittassa adhiṭṭhānaṭṭhena saddhābalaṃ, cittassa vodānaṭṭhena saddhābalaṃ, visesādhigamanaṭṭhena saddhābalaṃ, uttaripaṭivodhaṭṭhena saddhābalaṃ, saccābhisamayaṭṭhena saddhābalaṃ, nirodhe patiṭṭhāpakaṭṭhena saddhābalam.
ps2.9:4.3: sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ upatthambhanaṭṭhena viriyabalaṃ, kilesānaṃ pariyādānaṭṭhena viriyabalaṃ, paṭivedhādivisodhanaṭṭhena viriyabalaṃ, cittassa adhiṭṭhānaṭṭhena viriyabalaṃ, cittassa vodānaṭṭhena viriyabalaṃ, visesādhigamanaṭṭhena viriyabalaṃ, uttaripaṭivedhaṭṭhena viriyabalaṃ, saccābhisamayaṭṭhena viriyabalaṃ, nirodhe patiṭṭhāpakaṭṭhena viriyabalaṃ.
ps2.9:12.2: ‘Kāmacchandassa pahīnattā nekkhamme n' atthi kiñci vajjan' ti anavajjabalaṃ,
ps2.9:12.3: ‘byāpādassa pahīnattā abyāpāde n' atthi kiñci vajjan' ti anavajjabalaṃ,
ps2.9:12.4: ‘thīnamiddhassa pahīnattā ālokasaññāya n' atthi kiñci vajjan' ti anavajjabalaṃ,
ps2.9:12.5: ‘uddhaccassa pahīnattā avikkhepe n' atthi kiñci vajjan' ti anavajjabalaṃ,
ps2.9:12.6: ‘vicikicchāya pahīnattā dhammavavatthāve n' atthi kiñci vajjan' ti anavajjabalaṃ,
ps2.9:12.7: ‘avijjāya pahīnattā ñāṇe n' atthi kiñci vajjan' ti anavajjabalaṃ,
ps2.9:12.8: ‘aratiyā pahīnattā pāmojje n' atthi kiñci vajjan' ti anavajjabalaṃ,
ps2.9:12.9: ‘nīvaraṇānaṃ pahīnattā paṭhamajjhāne n' atthi kiñci vajjan' ti anavajjabalaṃ . . . pe . . .
ps2.9:12.10: ‘sabbakilesānaṃ pahīnattā Arahattamagge n' atthi kiñci vajjan' ti anavajjabalaṃ.
ps2.9:13.4: ‘thīnamiddhaṃ pajahanto ālokasaññāvasena cittaṃ saṅgaṇhātīti' saṅgahabalaṃ . . . pe . . .
ps2.9:15.5: ‘thīnamiddhaṃ pajahanto ālokasaññāvasena cittaṃ paññāpetīti' paññattibalaṃ . . . pe . . .
ps2.9:16.4: ‘thīnamiddhaṃ pajahanto ālokasaññāvasena cittaṃ nijjhāpetīti' nijjhantibalaṃ . . . pe . . .
ps2.9:17.2: ‘Kāmacchandaṃ pajahanto nekkhammavasena cittaṃ vasaṃ vattetīti' issariyabalaṃ,
ps2.9:17.3: ‘byāpādaṃ pajahanto abyāpādavasena cittaṃ vasaṃ vattetīti' issariyabalaṃ,
ps2.9:17.4: ‘thīnamiddhaṃ pajahanto ālokasaññāvasena cittaṃ vasaṃ vattetīti' issariyabalaṃ . . . pe . . .
ps2.9:17.5: ‘sabbakilese pajahanto Arahattamaggavasena cittaṃ vasaṃ vattetīti' issariyabalaṃ.
ps2.9:18.4: ‘thīnamiddhaṃ pajahanto ālokasaññāvasena cittaṃ adhiṭṭhātīti' adhiṭṭhānabalaṃ . . . pe . . .
ps2.9:19.2: Nekkhammavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samathabalaṃ, abyāpādavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samathabalaṃ, ālokasaññāvasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samathabalaṃ . . . pe . . .
ps2.9:19.3: paṭinissaggānupassī assāsavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samathabalaṃ, paṭinissaggānupassī passāsavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samathabalaṃ.
ps2.9:20.6: ‘ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā rūpasaññāya paṭighasaññāya nānattasaññāya na kampatīti' samathabalaṃ,
ps2.9:20.10: ‘uddhacce ca uddhaccasahagatakilese ca khandhe ca na kampati na calati na vedhatīti' samathabalaṃ.
ps2.9:21.3: paṭinissagānupassanā vipassanābalaṃ. Rūpe anniccānupassanā vipassanābalaṃ, rūpe dukkhānupassanā vipassanābalaṃ . . . pe . . .
ps2.9:21.9: jarāmaraṇe aniccānupassanā vipassanābalaṃ, jarāmaraṇe dukkhānupassanā vipassanābalaṃ,
ps2.9:21.19: ‘avijjāya ca avijjāsahagatakilese ca khandhe ca na kampati na calati na vedhatīti' vipassanābalaṃ.
ps2.9:22.17: Imāni dasa sekhabalāni, dasa asekhabalāni. Paṭis_II,IX.9:
ps2.9:23.2: Idha khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno aniccato sabbe saṅkhārā yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhā honti:
ps2.9:23.3: yaṃ pi khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno aniccato sabbe saṅkhārā yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhā honti, idaṃ pi khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno balaṃ hoti; yaṃ balaṃ āgamma khīṇāsavo bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayaṃ paṭijānāti -- ‘khīṇā me āsavā' ti.
ps2.9:24.1: Puna ca paraṃ, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno aṅgārakāsūpamā kāmā yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhā honti:
ps2.9:24.2: yaṃ pi khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno aṅgārakāsūpamā kāmā yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhā honti, idaṃ pi khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno balaṃ hoti; yaṃ balaṃ āgamma khīṇāsavo bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayaṃ paṭijānāti -- ‘khīṇā me āsavā' ti.
ps2.9:25.1: Puna ca paraṃ, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno vivekaninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāraṃ vivekaṭṭhaṃ nekkhammābhirataṃ byantibhūtaṃ sabbaso āsavaṭṭhāniyehi dhammehi:
ps2.9:25.2: yaṃ pi khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno vivekaninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāraṃ vivekaṭṭhaṃ nekkhammābhirataṃ byantibhūtaṃ sabbaso āsavaṭṭhāniyehi dhammehi, idaṃ pi khīnāsavassa bhikkhuno balaṃ hoti; yaṃ balaṃ āgamma khīṇāsavo bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayaṃ paṭijānāti -- ‘khīṇā me āsavā' ti.
ps2.9:26.1: Puna ca paraṃ, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā honti subhāvitā;
ps2.9:26.2: yaṃ pi khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā honti subhāvitā, idaṃ pi khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno balaṃ hoti; yaṃ balaṃ āgamma khīṇāsavo bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayaṃ paṭijānāti -- ‘khīṇā me āsavā' ti.
ps2.9:27.1: Puna ca paraṃ, khīnāsavassa bhikkhuno cattāro sammappadhānā bhāvitā honti subhāvitā . . . pe . . .
ps2.9:27.6: ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvito hoti subhāvito:
ps2.9:27.7: yaṃ pi khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvito hoti subhāvito, idaṃ pi khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno balaṃ hoti; yaṃ balaṃ āgamma khīṇāsavo bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayaṃ paṭijānāti -- ‘Khīṇā me āsavā' ti.
ps2.9:28.2: Adhiṭṭhānā iddhi, vikubbanā iddhi, manomayā iddhi, ñāṇavipphārā iddhi, samādhivipphārā iddhi, ariyā iddhi, kammavipākajā iddhi, puññavato iddhi, vijjāmayā iddhi, tattha tattha sammāpayogapaccayā ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhi.
ps2.9:29.2: Idha Tathāgato ṭhānañ ca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañ ca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti:
ps2.9:29.3: yaṃ pi Tathāgato ṭhānañ ca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañ ca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, idaṃ pi Tathāgatassa Tathāgatabalaṃ hoti; yaṃ balaṃ āgamma Tathāgato āsabhaṭṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.
ps2.9:30.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Tathāgato atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti:
ps2.9:30.2: yaṃ pi Tathāgato atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, idaṃ pi Tathāgatassa Tathāgatabalaṃ hoti; yaṃ balaṃ āgamma Tathāgato āsabhaṭṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.
ps2.9:31.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Tathāgato sabbatthagāminipaṭipadaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti:
ps2.9:31.2: yaṃ pi Tathāgato sabbatthagāminipaṭipadaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, idaṃ pi Tathāgatassa Tathāgatabalaṃ hoti; yaṃ balaṃ āgamma Tathāgato āsabhaṭṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.

ps2.9:32.2: yaṃ pi Tathāgato anekadhātunānādhātulokaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, idaṃ pi Tathāgatassa Tathāgatabalaṃ hoti . . . pe . . . brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.

ps2.9:33.2: yaṃ pi Tathāgato sattānaṃ nānādhimuttikataṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, idaṃ pi Tathāgatassa . . . pe . . . brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.

ps2.9:35.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Tathāgato jhāṇavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṅkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti:

ps2.9:36.2: ekaṃ pi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo . . . pe . . .
ps2.9:36.3: iti sākāraṃ sa-uddesaṃ anekaviditaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati:
ps2.9:36.4: yaṃ pi Tathāgato anekaviditaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati,
ps2.9:36.6: ekaṃ pi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo . . . pe . . .

ps2.9:37.2: yaṃ pi Tathāgato dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikantamānussakena . . . pe . . .
ps2.9:37.3: idaṃ pi Tathāgatassa . . . pe . . . brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.
ps2.9:38.1: Puna ca paraṃ, Tathāgato āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttim diṭṭhe 'va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññāya sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati:
ps2.9:38.2: yaṃ pi Tathāgato āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe 'va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññāya sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati, idaṃ pi Tathāgatassa Tathāgatabalaṃ hoti; yaṃ balaṃ āgamma Tathāgato āsabhaṭṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.
